name: freightswipe
description: FreightSwipe — shipper/trucker freight matching. React frontend and Express API deployed together on one Vercel domain.

scripts.vercel-build: prisma migrate deploy --schema=FreightSwipe-Backend/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema=FreightSwipe-Backend/prisma/schema.prisma && CI=false DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN=true npm run build --prefix freightswipe-frontend
scripts.db:reset-demo: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
